purpose: Extend the existing spatial proof from the original cover through ink, mountains, fog, village aerial, descent and entrance, before the two dialogue encounters.

timeline.source: ink-entry.js: stationary artwork, opacity-only irregular reveal; no lion-to-mountain morph
blender-spatial-view.js: mountain-entry framing; mountain-entry.json camera motion direction
storyboard-opening.js: original introduction text; source entry time3-8 inspired protected hold

provenance: Existing paid images listed in credits.json under revision 2k-layout-studies. No new generation requested or charged by this opening module.
limitations: The pre-existing 2K plates were authored from Blender references but are not verified exact per-building geometric reconstructions. Independent painted views use short dissolves; this is not a recovered continuous 3D traversal.
Existing entry.png is 1344x752, the other five painted plates are 2688x1520.

Ambient mist and two existing painted residents use independent elapsed time. Their forearm regions move in place; this does not create new residents, change faces, animate feet, or validate the earlier painting against every Blender coordinate.

displayWhiteBalance.applies: The same display-only transform to all opening plates; source media never overwritten.

api.progress: 0..1 is opening only; caller owns scrolling/timing and continuation to merchant. Aerial is .346.. .5; recommended seek uses openingStops.aerial=.3654.
api.elapsed: Independent real-time seconds. Update each animation frame while visible even if progress is unchanged.
api.opacity: Caller may fade overlay to its own 3D merchant view over a separate bridge interval; do not call hide until bridge ends.
api.createOpening(stage,options={}): Creates scoped DOM/canvas overlay at z-index2, below shared UI. Returns ready promise, update(progress,elapsed,opacity=1), hide(), stops, phase(progress), duration, destroy(). Also returns ambientCanvas and residentRegions. options.onFrame receives canvases, progress, phase, elapsed and region metadata; options.ambientFog/options.ambientExtras can disable a layer for isolated validation.

validation: JavaScript syntax checked with bundled Node.

Rendered actual module in Canvas2D at 1280x720, fixed progress, two different elapsed times. Entry change is confined to x400..432/y366..406 (1008 pixels); street to x964..992/y398..420 (492 pixels). No changed pixels outside these hand/forearm rectangles.

Two stationary frames per scene and difference maps saved under outputs/ink-pilot/opening-proof; these verify drawing logic without browser CSS color filter, DOM text or fog. Root browser integration/visual QA still needed.
Initial reveal values at elapsed0/.55/1.1/2.2 seconds are0/.25/.5/1.

initialCoverReveal.source: Original ink-entry.js coverAbsorb center (800,400) in 1600x900; smooth radius 1100. Fixed lion art revealed by an irregular opacity mask; first scroll completes initial reveal before landscape bridge.

ambientMist.layer: Separate unfiltered canvas, avoiding the art display white balance tint.

ambientResidents.method: Bilinear inverse UV sampling inside compact ellipses, each with zero displacement at its border. Original pixels replace the source patch with no copy blended over a stationary limb. All other pixels including faces, feet, walls and doors remain unchanged.

street.role: Existing right-side pair, left person folded hands
